rationale: PR #308 falsified that published CUSTOMER_EDUCATION can reach explanation/response contracts but not the real canonical D0 orchestration path. The repair adds a generic injected education-publication lookup and forwards its typed publications through the existing authority-enforced explanation entry without changing reasoning, product evidence, Decision Gate authority, or publication admission.
authority_impact: No new authority is introduced. II.EDUCATION.PUBLICATION_ADMISSION remains the only authority for customer-education publication; II.EXPLANATION.AUTHORITY_ENFORCEMENT continues to guard entry into explanation; II.ORCHESTRATION.EXECUTION_RUNTIME only transports already-published education to that guarded boundary.
